summary: Hallador Energy filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its credit agreement with Texas Capital Bank. The amendment revises financial maintenance covenants—total leverage capped at 4.25x and senior secured leverage stepping down from 3.00x to 2.50x over 2026–2027—to reflect improved risk profile from offtake agreements and support obligations under a previously announced Asset Purchase Agreement with Energy World Corporation. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation are mentioned. This is a routine covenant reset, not a standalone special situation.
